extraction_notes: The published ten-board panel4 placements and all retained element coordinates are unchanged.
Retains source connectivity, components, routed copper, pads, vias, board/component holes and silkscreen, including branding.
Omits schematic/CAD/solder-paste/courtyard/fabrication/keepout metadata because this is a PCB-view panelization regression.
Omits the published hand-authored panel cutouts and panel_-prefixed drills. The test regenerates panel slots and mouse bites using core.
The published project uses custom panel machining. This regression tests core tab routing on its actual board layout; it does not claim that the published custom machining is generated by core.
Tests read this local fixture only and never fetch the registry.
